children: RNS Number : 7992V  Insig AI Plc  22 September 2026
Posting of Annual Report and Accounts and notice of AGM

Insig AI plc (AIM: INSG), a leading provider of AI-led analytics and machine-learning solutions, announces that its annual report and accounts for the year ended 31 March 2026 (“Annual Report”) and notice of annual general meeting (“AGM”) have been posted to shareholders.
A copy of the Annual Report is available on the Company’s website at www.insig.ai/documents/annual-report-2026
The AGM will be held at 1 Heddon Street, London, W1B 4BD on 14 October 2026 at 2:00 p.m.
